counter_definitions.elements: sum len(ordered_reductions) only for successful PinnedTree.json returns at output/candidates/[0-9]{6}/reduction/reduction.json whose object and array entries have ordinary dict/list types; counts observed duplicates; no predicted rank/row multiplication
counter_definitions.file_bytes: sum len(raw) each time underlying PinnedTree.read read_bytes returns during this callback, before original full pin comparison; failed OS reads yield no bytes observation; includes repeated and non-JSON reads in any nested tree role
counter_definitions.json_documents: successful returns from the same existing PinnedTree.json parser boundary; no second parse
counter_definitions.ordered_documents: number of those ordinarily typed ordered arrays
counter_definitions.parse_input_bytes: sum lengths of raw buffers passed to that successful parser boundary, including repeated JSON reads; parse failures excluded here but their returned raw bytes remain in file_bytes
counter_definitions.read_calls: number of those returned byte buffers
counter_definitions.reparsed_bytes: sum those later successful parser raw lengths; parse_input_bytes = unique_json_bytes + reparsed_bytes
counter_definitions.reparsed_documents: later successful parser returns for an already successfully parsed identity
counter_definitions.reread_bytes: sum those later returned raw lengths; file_bytes = unique_read_bytes + reread_bytes
counter_definitions.reread_calls: later raw read returns of an already seen identity inside this callback
counter_definitions.unique_json_bytes: sum first successful parser input lengths for those identities
counter_definitions.unique_json_documents: distinct (tree role,path) first successful parse within this callback
counter_definitions.unique_read_bytes: sum first returned raw lengths for those identities
counter_definitions.unique_read_files: distinct (actual tree role, relative path) observed inside this one callback
counter_definitions.untyped_ordered_documents: candidate reduction parser returns without the ordinary dict/list-of-dict shape; observation becomes unavailable and original downstream predicates decide
counter_definitions.zero: COMPLETE may record actual zero reads/parses/elements for a callback using cached metadata; zero is scoped observation, never a directory census or assertion of no mathematical reductions

parent_inventory.actual_order: Actual tree_names files sorted; exact equality with self.files list before scan; enumerate self.files unchanged. Each descriptor count/hash is compared to observed hash_file result before aggregation. Directories compared separately and excluded from files/bytes.
parent_inventory.byte_count_provenance: hash_file count starts at integer0 and adds len(actual binary chunks); no bool count, no sum of descriptor declarations.

excluded.first_loads: First observed json.loads attempt per (role,path) within this native callback, with the same strict-hook scope as repeated_loads.
excluded.read_and_pin_overhead: Original PinnedTree.read whole call, minus nested measured sha calls. Includes path/type/cap checks, physical read, pin comparison and existing observer overhead. This is an explicit read/pin window, not a claim of pure OS I/O time.
excluded.unidentified_loads: Observed json.loads call with no safe role/path context.

nonoverlap.method: Each timed original call has a stack frame with monotonic start and accumulated full durations of its directly nested measured calls. Its exclusive duration is elapsed minus those child inclusive durations. The child's full duration is charged once to the parent subtraction; the child's exclusive value is charged once to its own category.
nonoverlap.outside: Do not add native outer seconds or existing authentication/parent timing seconds to this partition. Callback observation overhead is described, not subtracted using a guessed constant.
nonoverlap.same_category: Nested calls in the same category still subtract and re-add exclusively; no double counting.

canonical_reserialization.boundary: Calls through this C module's local canonical alias to the captured original callable, once with the same object. All original canonical internals are included. Imported modules' other direct canonical bindings remain outside this wrapper.
canonical_reserialization.nesting: When canonical is a child of seal/same_json, its full measured call duration is subtracted from its parent's exclusive interval.

repeated_loads.boundary: Only the original json.loads call within own json_value; UTF-8 decoding occurs before the timed call. Original duplicate-key object_pairs_hook and parse_constant execution are included.
repeated_loads.bytes: Input raw length and same-parser counts remain separately in existing scoped byte observations; this timer adds no reparse.
repeated_loads.identity: (ordinary role, relative path) propagated from the same SavedParentJsonBytes.parse invocation; occurrence count resets for each one native-metadata callback.
repeated_loads.repeat_rule: Second or later observed loads attempt for that identity in the same callback. No extra raw read, digest, parser, source import or replay. A first attempt that raises is still an observed attempt.
repeated_loads.unidentified: Loads outside an identified SavedParentJsonBytes.parse are kept in excluded.unidentified_loads, never guessed to be repeated.

seal_and_metadata_helper_loops.boundary: Explicit whole-function windows for check_document, same_json, batch_bound, check_file_descriptor; PinnedTree.expected; and the eight native role/header/projection/keyset/inventory helper families reached by ordinary native-metadata callbacks. The final source ticket enumerates every installed symbol and caller.
seal_and_metadata_helper_loops.meaning: Exclusive time of these named original metadata helpers after all nested measured child durations are removed. Includes their own seal, equality, ordinary-type, descriptor and metadata loops. It does not mean every inline loop in the native callback.
seal_and_metadata_helper_loops.not_a_residual: The remaining elapsed time is separately unattributed_seconds; it is never relabelled seal time.

sha256.boundary: Calls through this C module's local sha alias to the captured original callable, once with identical raw object. All original sha internals are included. Direct hashlib streaming and imported modules' distinct aliases are outside this wrapper.
sha256.nesting: Child sha intervals are subtracted from enclosing read/pin or seal helper windows. No monkey-patch of hashlib or imported C module.

native_operations15.original_exception_priority: Original FAILED always remains FAILED even when timing also faults. All primary observations remain null; if observer rows are unreliable partial.operations and partial.excluded are null. Actual valid callback elapsed may remain. Logger errors cannot replace the original exception.
native_operations15.partial_row_unavailability: If registration or any observer update is incomplete, both counter objects are null. When observed counters remain valid after an original callback exception, their actual scoped prefix is retained. A negative but finite residual is retained signed in partial and makes a returning callback UNAVAILABLE.

scope.independence: C scope is independent of P and is not forced into P operation scopes.
scope.outer: Exactly eight ordinary native-metadata callbacks; after operation STARTED publication through original return/raise, before operation terminal publication.

native_operations15.scope_completion: No-call=0 is valid only for a complete initialized callback window after the entire explicit local hook roster installed. Missing/disabled setup is not such a window. Unwrapped imported aliases and inline work are deliberately outside the observed categories.

unattributed.formula: outer_elapsed_seconds - sum(operation exclusive seconds) - sum(excluded exclusive seconds)
unattributed.negative: Retain the signed observed value. A negative value or invalid timer/counter observation makes operation status UNAVAILABLE and leaves primary values null; never clamp to zero or treat it as a PASS gate.

wire.COMPLETE: All four primary values observed and populated; partial=null. No mathematical success implied.
wire.FAILED: Original callback raised. All primary values null. partial contains exactly the four primary keys with the actual reached timing/counter prefix; partial is not a full callback partition.
wire.UNAVAILABLE: Original callback may have returned, but one or more timing observations failed. All primary values null; partial contains the four reached primary observations, with null only where unavailable. It is not a mathematical rejection.

wire.event_order: For each of eight native callbacks, operation STARTED occurs within the existing authentication STARTED/terminal pair. Operation terminal is formed from original return/raise and precedes the existing authentication terminal. Later callbacks can be absent after an exception.
wire.logger_failure: Missing event remains missing. Emission failure is swallowed and cannot alter the original callback outcome.

unwind_rules.empty_callback: COMPLETE zero bytes/elements is allowed for cached-metadata-only callback; scope does not imply no arithmetic work

unwind_rules.partial_invariants: all partial fields are observed prefixes; diagnostic hook failure may interrupt a counter update, so arithmetic counter identities are asserted only for COMPLETE available observations
unwind_rules.selftest: no authentication registration or events from selftest branch; old fixture execution remains separate
